<b>Shellwood Gnats</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are tiny, green flying bugs encased in dark Shellwood, with a flying and a crawling variant.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
<b>Winged Variant:</b> Hangs from the ceiling, shaking and chirping before popping off it once Hornet gets near. Attacks by slowly flying towards Hornet, attempting to deal contact damage.<br>
If Hornet gets out of its range for a few seconds, it flies up and re-nestles into the nearest ceiling.

<b>Wingless Variant:</b> Disguises itself either on the ground or on the ceiling, shaking and chirping before popping out once Hornet gets near. Simply walks back and forth, turning around once it reaches an edge or a wall.<br>
If Hornet gets out of its range for a few seconds, it disguises itself on the ground again.

In either case, once their protective shell is broken, it shatters into [[Shell Shards]], and the inner winged bug pops out of it and begins or continues flying.<br>
Their unarmoured self moves a lot faster than their flying shelled version, but with significantly poorer control and traction.
Despite being unprotected, they still attempt to fly into Hornet to deal contact damage.

Both variants of the Shellwood Gnat deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

The entry for the Hunter's Journal will only be successfully completed if the true form of the [[Shellwood Gnat]] is eliminated.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Shellwood Gnats have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Shellwood Gnats can be found primarily in [[Shellwood]], but they can also be found in the [[Memorium]].
